text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Right. That should be most of it 
cleared away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That will be all for today's practice and 
cleaning, then. 
Time to head back to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? 
There was still dust left in the corner, 
was there?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To not only sully this sacred dojo, 
but to insolently refuse to budge... How 
impudent.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It has come to this, then—by force. 
I shall have you surrender this sacred 
hall of training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Becoming far too absorbed in her cleaning, 
Phalaenopsis 
ended up skipping her training session.
